verdict.rationale: MailerSend is an API-first transactional email service, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. The pack has no evidence of one: probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt documentation index is a different, adjacent artifact and is not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
